desc:
CARRY THE GLASS WITH A FRIEND 2 PLAYER CO-OP OBBY

Carry the glass through a dangerous obstacle course in Bring the Glass, a 2 player co-op obby where you and a friend must protect a fragile pane all the way to the top.

Coordinate your movements, tilt the glass through tight gaps, dodge swinging hammers and reach each checkpoint without letting it shatter. One wrong move can break everything!

🤝 2-PLAYER CO-OP  you can’t do it alone
🪟 FRAGILE GLASS  one wrong move and it shatters
🏗️ REACH THE TOP of the tower together
💾 CHECKPOINTS  no need to restart from the beginning

🎮 NOW ON CONSOLE! Play on console, PC, phone or tablet controller supported.

👥 JOIN THE GROUP & FOLLOW THE COMMUNITY! Join our Roblox group and follow the community to stay updated with new content, improvements, announcements, and more!

This is an early beta made by a passionate solo developer. It’s my first Roblox game, and I’m still actively improving it, fixing bugs and adding new content. Honest feedback
